description: Invoice a customer, finalize it, mark it paid outside Stripe, then read what was collected.
note: basil's multiple-payments entry is mostly schema — six removed Invoice fields and three added ones, all of which an OpenAPI diff reports. One line of it is behavioral: amount_paid now reflects out-of-band payments. The underlying invoice_payment records 2000 on both versions, so the money is in the same place; it is the aggregate a reconciliation job reads that disagrees (docs/m6-m8-probe.md).

steps.note: send_invoice, not charge_automatically: an invoice paid outside Stripe is one the customer was billed for and settled by wire or check.

Attached to the invoice by id rather than left pending. A pending item is not pulled into a draft invoice on either version, and an empty finalized invoice goes straight to paid with nothing owed — which looks exactly like a break that cannot be exercised.
The positive control for this scenario: amount_due is 2000 on both versions here, before any payment, so a later absence of difference cannot be a broken scenario.
The observable: amount_paid is 0 on A and 2000 on basil, amount_remaining inverts with it, and neither field is named once in the 702 breaking entries oasdiff produces for this object.
